annotations.title: Record visits for the journey map

description: Open, extend or stop the on-demand visit recording window for the Journey optimizer. Apps whose Mushi Mushi SDK runs trackSessions: 'on-demand' send no visits until a window is open; then that share of visitors is recorded until it ends (apps on the default trackSessions: true always record). hours is 1 to 168 from now, or 0 to stop; optional sampleRate is the share of visitors, above 0 and at most 1 (0.1 = one in ten; unset keeps the current share, 0.1 by default), and projectId. Returns { recording: { until, sampleRate }, next } (until null = off). Calling it again replaces the window. Viewers cannot record. Write: it changes the app's recording setting; nothing in the repo changes. Read the results with get_journeys.

hours.description: Hours to record from now (1-168), or 0 to stop

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

sampleRate.description: Share of visitors to record, above 0 and at most 1 (0.1 = one in ten)
